column1: # CalendarRule vectors: every implementation of the rule (Rust
#   zone        rule `time_zone` (IANA name), `-` for None (local wall clock)
#   local       the zone standing in for the device's when `zone` is `-`
#   until       rule `until_ms` as an RFC 3339 UTC instant, `-` for None
#   after       the instant to search after, RFC 3339 UTC
#   count       how many occurrences to ask for (each strictly after the previous)
#   expected    comma-separated RFC 3339 UTC instants, fewer than `count` when
#               the rule runs out; `none` when there is no occurrence at all
# Semantics: a wall time in a DST gap moves forward by the gap; a wall
# time in an overlap is the earlier instant and fires once; a day that
# does not match every set field is skipped.
